packages.title: Stremio Origin
packages.shortDescription: Native app for Stremio addons on LG webOS TVs. Unofficial.

manifest.title: Stremio Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Arabic titles, built in: Titles and descriptions come in Arabic or English with nothing to add. Switch any time in Settings › Language.
Links open on your phone: A link from an addon shows a code: scan it and the app's site tells you where it goes, then opens it with one tap.
Help in one scan: Settings › About › Share logs opens a page with your code and a report ready to send.
Updates that get through: The app checks GitHub, then its site. Rooted TVs can also install and update it from Homebrew Channel.
